info.name: FLUX.1-dev on Runpod Serverless
info.description: Calls the FLUX.1-dev Serverless endpoint and Runpod's FLUX.1-dev Public Endpoint with the same request. Select the Runpod environment, set apiKey and endpointId, then send Generate. The Visualize tab of the response shows the image.

request.description: Waits for the image. After a cold start the wait can end before the image is ready. Then send Status, which uses the saved job ID.
Queues a job and saves its ID for Status and Cancel. The policy expires the job after 10 minutes.
Reads the saved job. Results stay available for 30 minutes after the job completes.
Cancels the saved job, so a job nobody waits for stops billing.
Job counts by state and worker counts by state.

The same request on Runpod's FLUX.1-dev Public Endpoint, billed per image. The response reports the cost. The response holds an image URL in result, which Runpod's docs name image_url, instead of image_base64.
